name: wordmark decodes to its final form before the CTA
looks: The brand wordmark flickers through scrambled glyphs, one letter lagging and glitching after the rest lock in, before resolving fully. A bold closing claim and the destination URL fade up beneath it a beat later.
build: end-card-decode: each letter scrambles through random glyphs on a seeded per-frame pick and locks to its real letter on a staggered time, one letter deliberately lagging for a last flicker; the claim and URL reveal on a clipPath wipe once the mark locks.
sound: Glitch ticks under the decode, a hit on the final lock, quiet under the claim.
prompt: Let the brand wordmark flicker through scrambled glyphs before locking into its real letters, with one letter lagging behind the rest for a last flicker of tension. Settle into a bold closing claim and the destination URL once the mark fully resolves.
